title: [Radio’ Clock] Tea Time Monday with Kim So Ra (김소라)
description:
🌟 한국의 전통 타악을 세계에 알리는🗺 전북특별자치도 무형유산 정읍농악 이수자✨️김소라 님과 함께했습니다❤️

혼자서 타악 솔리스트로도 공연하고,🥨 북을 연주하는 남편과 함께 하기도,🍒
가야금을 연주하는 친구와 함께 듀오벗으로 활동하면서🌿 다양한 연주를 보여주고 계신데요 ❤️ 🔥

오늘 방송을 위해 3개의 장구를 가져와서✨️ 열정적인 연주도 들려주셨는데요😲
앞으로도 계속해서 전 세계에 타악을 알리고 싶다고 하셨는데요😊
그 목표 꼭 이루시길 응원하겠습니다🍀🫶🏻
🌟 We were with Korean Percussionist Kim So Ra.

She is a certified Jeongeup Nongak performer from Jeonbuk Special Autonomous Province. And she is dedicated to promoting traditional Korean percussion to the world🗺✨️

She performs as a solo percussionist🥨, sometimes with her husband who plays the buk (Korean drum),🍒 and also with her friend who plays the gayageum in their duo called 'DUO BUD'🌿, showcasing a variety of performances❤️ 🔥

For today's broadcast, she brought three janggu (Korean double-headed drums)✨️ and gave us an enthusiastic performance😲. 

She expressed her desire to continue spreading Korean percussion around the world😊. 

We wholeheartedly support her in achieving this goal🍀.
